Title: Diagnosis
Details: The failing test `isUnixSymlinkIsFalseIfMoreThanOneFlagIsSet` checks that a ZipArchiveEntry is not identified as a Unix symlink when more than one flag is set in the Unix mode. The method under test, `isUnixSymlink`, returns true if the Unix mode bitwise AND with `UnixStat.LINK_FLAG` equals `LINK_FLAG`. This essentially checks whether the specific link bit is set, without confirming if other bits are set concurrently.

Looking at the code of `ZipArchiveEntry.isUnixSymlink()`:
```java
public boolean isUnixSymlink() {
    return (getUnixMode() & UnixStat.LINK_FLAG) == UnixStat.LINK_FLAG;
}
```
it directly checks the presence of the link bit flag.

`getUnixMode()` is defined as:
```java
public int getUnixMode() {
    return platform != PLATFORM_UNIX ? 0 :
        (int) ((getExternalAttributes() >> SHORT_SHIFT) & SHORT_MASK);
}
```
which extracts Unix permission bits from external attributes if the platform is Unix.

`UnixStat.LINK_FLAG` is defined as octal `0120000`, meaning it expects that only the link bit is set to represent a symlink.

The problem reported in the bug is that `isUnixSymlink()` returns true for entries where the mode has multiple flags set, like `177777`, which means more than just the link bit is set (e.g., sticky, other flags). The test expects it to return false if extra flags are set together with the link bit.

The current implementation only checks if the link bit is set, but does not verify if it is *the only* flag set. Thus, if multiple flags are set alongside the link flag, `isUnixSymlink()` returns true incorrectly.

Hence, the cause of failure is that `isUnixSymlink()` does not verify exclusivity of the link flag and considers any mode with link bit set (including multiple bits) as a symlink, leading to false positives when more than one flag is present.

This diagnosis matches the test intent and the bug report: the method must distinguish between pure symlink mode and mixed modes, but currently does not.

Recent bug reports are unrelated and do not affect this diagnosis.

The fix should be in `ZipArchiveEntry.isUnixSymlink()` to ensure it returns true only if the mode bits equal exactly the link flag, or at least that no other mode bits beyond the link flag are set.

Based on the available information, provide the signatures of the most likely culprit methods for the bug. Your answer will be processed automatically, so make sure to only answer with the accurate signatures of all likely culprits (in `ClassName.MethodName(ArgType1, ArgType2, ...)` format), without commentary (one per line).
